elevenlabs-dicechess-host-prowla.title: Dice Chess Hot Seat host Prowla (ElevenLabs)

elevenlabs-dicechess-tutorial-thinkle.title: Dice Chess TV tutorial, taught by Thinkle (ElevenLabs)

grabby_capture_1.text: Mine! I'll take that, thank you.

grabby_capture_2.text: Another piece added to my private collection.

grabby_capture_3.text: Yoink! You shouldn't leave valuables lying around.

grabby_capture_heavy_1.text: Jackpot! That prize piece is mine!

grabby_capture_heavy_2.text: Exquisite loot! A crown jewel for my hoard!

grabby_capture_heavy_3.text: The bigger the piece, the sweeter the profit!

grabby_empty_roll_1.text: No moves?! But I wanted to take something!

grabby_empty_roll_2.text: A waste of a roll! No loot for my vault this turn.

grabby_empty_roll_3.text: Empty roll! You got lucky... for now.

grabby_intro_1.text: Everything on this board belongs in my collection.

grabby_intro_2.text: Don't get attached to your pieces. I'm taking them all.

grabby_intro_3.text: A fresh board! So many shiny pieces to hoard.

grabby_loss_1.text: No! My glorious collection! How dare you?!

grabby_threat_1.text: Your king would look lovely in my vault.

grabby_threat_2.text: One good roll and your king is mine!

grabby_threat_3.text: I spy your king. Very collectible!

grabby_win_1.text: Victory and total plunder! What a splendid haul!

grabby_win_2.text: All your squares and treasures are mine!

grabby_win_3.text: Greed is good, but winning is priceless!

host_again_1.text: Another game? Yay, more cheering for me!

host_again_2.text: New game, new luck! Who's ready?

host_again_3.text: Back for more? The dice are all warmed up!

host_black_wins_1.text: Black takes the game! Well played, both!

host_black_wins_2.text: It's Black's game! What a match, you two!

host_black_wins_3.text: Three cheers for Black, and for White too!

host_capture_1.text: Pop! One piece hops off the board!

host_capture_3.text: A capture! A little more room on the board!

host_capture_4.text: And that piece is off for a little rest!

host_capture_heavy_1.text: Wowee! The whole board felt that one!

host_capture_heavy_2.text: Kaboom! A mighty piece leaves the board!

host_capture_heavy_4.text: Big, big moment! Somebody pinch me!

host_capture_heavy_5.text: Oh my! Hold on to your seats, you two!

host_capture_queen_1.text: A queen is taken! Deep breaths, you two!

host_capture_queen_2.text: Oh, the queen! My heart just did a flip!

host_capture_queen_4.text: Queen down! My microphone is shaking!

host_draw_1.text: A draw! Nobody wins, and everybody wins!

host_draw_2.text: It's a draw! You two are perfectly matched!

host_draw_3.text: All even! Shake hands, both of you!

host_empty_roll_1.text: The dice said no! Pass it along!

host_empty_roll_2.text: Aww, bad luck! Those dice are so cheeky!

host_empty_roll_3.text: Oh no, the dice took a nap! Next turn!

host_empty_roll_4.text: Uh-oh! The dice are playing tricks on us!

host_en_passant_1.text: En passant! A rare sideways capture!

host_en_passant_2.text: Did you see that? A pawn caught in passing!

host_handoff_1.text: Now pass the remote over! Black's turn!

host_handoff_2.text: After every turn, the remote changes hands!

host_handoff_3.text: Remote swap time! Black, roll away!

host_intro_1.text: You two play, and I'll do the cheering!

host_intro_2.text: No dice for me! I'm just the host!

host_intro_3.text: Welcome, both of you! White rolls first!

host_intro_4.text: One board, two players, three dice! Go!

host_intro_5.text: Ooh, a brand new game... I can't wait!

host_promotion_1.text: Look! That little pawn grew up!

host_promotion_2.text: A pawn crossed the whole board! Amazing!

host_promotion_3.text: Ta-da! The pawn got a big upgrade!

host_white_wins_1.text: White wins! What a game, both of you!

host_white_wins_2.text: Victory for White! You both played great!

host_white_wins_3.text: Hooray, White! And hooray, Black, too!

host_win_1.text: And that's the game! Bravo, you two!

host_win_2.text: We have a winner! Great game, everyone!

prowla_host_again_1.text: Another round? Oh, I hoped you'd say that.

prowla_host_again_2.text: Again? My tail is twitching already.

prowla_host_again_3.text: Fresh board, fresh chase. Off you go.

prowla_host_again_4.text: Back so soon? I adore a rematch.

prowla_host_black_wins_1.text: Black takes the game! Lovely, you two.

prowla_host_black_wins_2.text: The game goes to Black. Well played, White.

prowla_host_black_wins_3.text: Black pounces last. What a chase, darlings.

prowla_host_capture_1.text: Caught! One piece leaves the board.

prowla_host_capture_3.text: Mmm, a capture. Things are warming up.

prowla_host_capture_4.text: Off it goes. The board breathes a little.

prowla_host_capture_5.text: Shh... a piece just slipped away.

prowla_host_capture_heavy_1.text: Oh my! A big piece leaves the board.

prowla_host_capture_heavy_2.text: Now that was a proper pounce.

prowla_host_capture_heavy_3.text: My whiskers felt that one, darlings.

prowla_host_capture_heavy_4.text: What a catch! The whole board shivers.

prowla_host_capture_heavy_5.text: A grand piece gone. Now it gets serious.

prowla_host_capture_queen_1.text: A queen falls! Oh, I adore drama.

prowla_host_capture_queen_3.text: The queen! Now we have a game.

prowla_host_capture_queen_4.text: Farewell, Your Majesty. What a moment.

prowla_host_draw_1.text: A draw! Two paws, perfectly matched.

prowla_host_draw_3.text: A draw! You two are far too well matched.

prowla_host_empty_roll_1.text: The dice say no. Pass it along, darling.

prowla_host_empty_roll_2.text: No move at all? The dice are teasing.

prowla_host_empty_roll_3.text: Nothing to play? Even a cat must wait.

prowla_host_empty_roll_4.text: The dice took a catnap. Next turn.

prowla_host_en_passant_1.text: En passant! Caught in passing, darlings.

prowla_host_en_passant_2.text: Sneaky! A pawn caught en passant.

prowla_host_en_passant_3.text: Psst... that sideways catch is en passant.

prowla_host_handoff_1.text: Now pass the remote, darling. Black's turn.

prowla_host_handoff_2.text: Paw it over. The remote moves every turn.

prowla_host_handoff_3.text: Remote to Black, please. Gently now.

prowla_host_intro_1.text: Two players, one board. How delicious.

prowla_host_intro_2.text: Mmm, a game for two. I'll watch from here.

prowla_host_intro_4.text: Don't mind me... I'm only here to purr.

prowla_host_intro_5.text: No dice for me, darlings. I only watch.

prowla_host_promotion_1.text: A pawn crossed the board! How bold.

prowla_host_promotion_2.text: Look who grew up. A brand new piece!

prowla_host_promotion_3.text: From little pawn to something grand.

prowla_host_promotion_4.text: All the way across? Well done, little one.

prowla_host_white_wins_1.text: White wins! Bravo, both of you.

prowla_host_white_wins_2.text: The game goes to White. Well played, Black.

prowla_host_white_wins_3.text: White takes it. What a chase, you two.

prowla_host_win_1.text: And the game is caught. Bravo, you two.

prowla_host_win_3.text: That's the game, darlings. What fun.

rampage_capture_1.text: Obliterated! One less obstacle in my path.

rampage_capture_2.text: Cut down! Your ranks crumble before me.

rampage_capture_heavy_1.text: Crushed! Your mightiest defender falls into dust!

rampage_capture_heavy_2.text: Devastating strike! You cannot withstand my assault!

rampage_capture_heavy_3.text: Your high command is broken! Smashed to pieces!

rampage_empty_roll_1.text: The dice stall my fury. Savor your brief respite.

rampage_empty_roll_2.text: No targets?! Unacceptable! Next turn you fall.

rampage_empty_roll_3.text: A momentary pause before the storm resumes.

rampage_intro_1.text: Step forward. Your king will not survive this day.

rampage_intro_2.text: No mercy. No retreat. Let the battle begin.

rampage_intro_3.text: Prepare yourself! I strike without hesitation.

rampage_loss_1.text: Impossible! How could my onslaught fail?!

rampage_loss_2.text: You fought fiercely... I acknowledge your triumph.

rampage_loss_3.text: Downed, but not broken! We will battle again!

rampage_threat_1.text: Your king is in my sights!

rampage_threat_2.text: The right roll, and your king falls!

rampage_threat_3.text: I can smell your king's fear!

rampage_win_1.text: Total annihilation! Kneel before the conqueror!

rampage_win_2.text: Your army is crushed beneath my heel!

rampage_win_3.text: Victory was inevitable! You were completely outmatched!

rolly_capture_2.text: Got one! Every little piece counts!

rolly_capture_heavy_1.text: Whoa! Did I really just grab that big piece?!

rolly_capture_heavy_2.text: Look what I found! Down goes a heavy hitter!

rolly_capture_heavy_3.text: Yay! That was a huge capture!

rolly_empty_roll_1.text: Oops, nowhere to go! Your turn!

rolly_empty_roll_2.text: Nothing to move? That's dice for you!

rolly_empty_roll_3.text: A blank roll! Well, that was silly!

rolly_intro_1.text: Hey! Let's roll and see what happens!

rolly_intro_2.text: Dice ready, board ready! Let's have fun!

rolly_intro_3.text: I love rolling dice! Hope they're friendly today!

rolly_loss_1.text: Aww, good game! You got me fair and square!

rolly_loss_3.text: You're too good! Let's play another round!

rolly_threat_1.text: Ooh! Your king is right in my path!

rolly_threat_2.text: One lucky roll and your king goes boop!

rolly_threat_3.text: Psst... your king might want to hide!

rolly_win_1.text: Yay, I won! Can we roll again?!

rolly_win_2.text: Woohoo! The dice were super friendly today!

rolly_win_3.text: High five! That was so much fun!

thinkle_tutor_capture_done_1.text: Splendid! The dice chose the rook; you chose the target.

thinkle_tutor_capture_opening_1.text: Now for the fun part: taking pieces!

thinkle_tutor_capture_opening_2.text: Land on an enemy piece, and it leaves the board.

thinkle_tutor_capture_rolled_1.text: A rook, a queen and a bishop.

thinkle_tutor_capture_rolled_2.text: You have no queen or bishop here, so those dice go grey.

thinkle_tutor_capture_rolled_3.text: The rook will do nicely. See that black pawn?

thinkle_tutor_clear_done_1.text: All three used! Use every die you can: that is the rule.

thinkle_tutor_clear_moved_1.text: The way is open! Use the dice that are left.

thinkle_tutor_clear_opening_1.text: Sometimes a piece is stuck behind its own pawns.

thinkle_tutor_clear_opening_2.text: Then move a pawn first, and set it free!

thinkle_tutor_clear_rolled_1.text: A pawn, a bishop and a queen.

thinkle_tutor_clear_rolled_2.text: The bishop and queen are stuck, yet their dice are lit.

thinkle_tutor_clear_rolled_3.text: Only pawns that open the way glow. Move one first!

thinkle_tutor_closing_1.text: Castling, promotion and en passant use dice too.

thinkle_tutor_closing_2.text: Rules, on the home screen, has every detail.

thinkle_tutor_closing_3.text: May the stars and the dice be kind to you!

thinkle_tutor_dice_done_1.text: Well leapt! The grey dice go unused, and the turn ends.

thinkle_tutor_dice_opening_1.text: Now, a little secret of the dice.

thinkle_tutor_dice_opening_2.text: Each die shows a piece, and only that piece may move.

thinkle_tutor_dice_opening_3.text: Roll, and let us see what they choose.

thinkle_tutor_dice_rolled_1.text: Hmm... a queen, a bishop and a knight.

thinkle_tutor_dice_rolled_2.text: The queen and bishop are boxed in. Their dice go grey.

thinkle_tutor_dice_rolled_3.text: But a knight can leap over pieces!

thinkle_tutor_king_done_1.text: Victory! Taking the king wins at once.

thinkle_tutor_king_done_2.text: Nothing warns you when a king is attacked. Guard yours!

thinkle_tutor_king_opening_1.text: Now, the most important rule of all.

thinkle_tutor_king_opening_2.text: Whoever takes the other king wins, there and then.

thinkle_tutor_king_rolled_1.text: A rook, and nothing between it and the king.

thinkle_tutor_missed_1.text: Not quite, my friend. Let us try that again.

thinkle_tutor_move_done_1.text: There! Three dice, three moves: your first turn.

thinkle_tutor_move_moved_1.text: Well done! Each die is one move. Use them all.

thinkle_tutor_move_opening_2.text: I am Thinkle, and I shall teach you Dice Chess.

thinkle_tutor_move_opening_3.text: Every turn begins with a roll of the dice.

thinkle_tutor_move_rolled_1.text: Three pawns! So your pawns may move, and they glow.

thinkle_tutor_move_rolled_2.text: Pick one, and the dots show where it may go.

thinkle_tutor_pass_done_1.text: No harm done! At the start of a game, it happens often.

thinkle_tutor_pass_opening_1.text: Now and then, the dice play a little trick.

thinkle_tutor_pass_opening_2.text: Roll, and you will see what I mean.

thinkle_tutor_pass_rolled_1.text: Hmm... a queen, a rook and a king.

thinkle_tutor_pass_rolled_2.text: All three are boxed in, so every die goes grey.

thinkle_tutor_pass_rolled_3.text: When no die can be used, your turn simply passes.
